Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.normalized_requirement: The census-based approach applies only to projects involving direct planting.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.source_span_text: 1) applies only to projects that involve direct planting.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Planting density under the census-based approach is limited to 50 planting units per hectare.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.source_span_text: 2) limits planting density to a maximum of 50 planting units per hectare.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.normalized_requirement: A complete census of all planting units must establish N at t=0.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.source_span_text: 3) uses a complete census of all planting units (established as N, the total number of planting units) at t=0.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Biomass is estimated by sampling and measuring planting units and scaled to project level using N.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.source_span_text: 4) estimates biomass through sampling and measurement of planting units, then scales to the project level using the number of planting units (N) as a multiplier.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.normalized_requirement: The census-based approach uses a project method for additionality and the crediting baseline.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.source_span_text: 5) uses a project method to demonstrate additionality and determine the crediting baseline.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.normalized_requirement: The census-based approach is exempt from leakage deduction because existing land use must not change.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-1-2-0001.source_span_text: 6) is exempt from applying a leakage deduction because projects must not result in a change to existing land use.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-1-0001.normalized_requirement: Project activities must increase vegetative cover.
Where area-based and census-based approaches are combined, they must occupy non-overlapping areas defined at project start.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-1-0001.source_span_text: 2) Where area-based and census-based approaches are used together, they are applied in non-overlapping areas defined at the project start (see Section 5 on the delineation of spatial boundaries to ensure non-overlap).

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-1-0001.normalized_requirement: The quantification approach selected at project start must be used for the entire crediting period.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-1-0001.source_span_text: 3) For lands enrolled in a project, the quantification approach is selected at the project start date and used for the entire project crediting period.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-1-0001.normalized_requirement: The project start date must be documented as the earlier of site preparation start or land use change date.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-1-0001.source_span_text: 4) The project start date is documented as the earliest of the following: a) The date on which site preparation activities began; b) The land use change date

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-1-0001.normalized_requirement: Projects on organic soils or wetlands must use a multiple-project-activity design, applying VM0047 for aboveground biomass and an applicable WRC methodology for other pools.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-1-0001.source_span_text: 5) Where projects take place on organic soils or wetlands, ARR activities are developed using a multiple project activity design, applying this methodology to account for aboveground biomass and using a Wetland Restoration and Conservation methodology (e.g., VM0036 Methodology for Rewetting Drained Temperate Peatlands) to account for other carbon pools.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-3-0001.normalized_requirement: Census-based project activities must include only direct planting.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-3-0001.source_span_text: 1) The project activity only includes direct planting.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-3-0001.normalized_requirement: Pre-project land use must be maintained throughout the project lifetime.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-3-0001.source_span_text: 2) The pre-project land use is maintained throughout the project lifetime (e.g., where projects occur on agricultural land, agricultural production continues).

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-3-0001.normalized_requirement: Planting density must not exceed 50 units per hectare, scaled proportionally for partial-hectare instances and dispersed across larger instances.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-3-0001.source_span_text: 3) Planting density does not exceed 50 planting units per hectare. The planting density limit applies proportionally to the size of each instance: a) Where an instance is less than one hectare or includes part of a hectare (e.g., 0.50 ha or 1.50 ha, respectively), the planting density is scaled proportionally to the size of the instance. For example, an instance of 0.50 hectares may include no more than 25 planting units. b) In instances larger than one hectare, planting is dispersed to maintain compliance with the 50 planting units per hectare limit across the entire instance (e.g., in a 10-hectare instance, up to 500 planting units may be planted, but must not be concentrated in a single hectare or portion of the instance).

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The complete census marks project start and t=0, establishes N, includes only project-planted units, and excludes existing vegetation from N and the density threshold.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-3-0001.source_span_text: 4) The establishment of a complete census of all planting units marks the start of the project and is t = 0. The census is conducted to establish N, the total number of planting units. Only planting units planted by the project proponent are included in the census. Existing vegetation is not included in the census and does not count toward the 50 planting units per hectare density threshold.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-4-1-0001.normalized_requirement: Area-based projects are excluded on lands meeting the managed-forest definition during the ten years before project start.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-4-1-0001.source_span_text: 1) The project occurs on lands that have met the definition of managed forest at any point in the 10-year period immediately preceding the project start date.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-4-1-0001.normalized_requirement: Area-based projects are excluded where clearing pre-existing woody biomass involves timber harvesting or degrades native ecosystems.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-4-1-0001.source_span_text: 2) Clearing of pre-existing woody biomass involves timber harvesting or results in degradation of native ecosystems.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-4-1-0001.normalized_requirement: Area-based projects are excluded where fewer than 50 planting units per hectare are planted and the census-based approach could be used.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-4-1-0001.source_span_text: 3) The project is planting fewer than 50 planting units per hectare and could use the census-based approach.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-4-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Census-based projects are excluded where similarly purposed woody biomass was removed in the prior ten years.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-4-2-0001.source_span_text: 1) Woody biomass, which serves a similar purpose as the planting units in the project, has been removed within the last 10 years (confirmed via pre-project photos and/or attestation).

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-4-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Census-based projects are excluded where project soil disturbance involves inversion deeper than 25 cm.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-4-4-2-0001.source_span_text: 2) Soil disturbance from the project activity involves soil inversion to a depth exceeding 25 cm (e.g., that would result from a moldboard plow).

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-5-0001.normalized_requirement: Where both quantification approaches are used, their accounting boundaries must not overlap.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-5-0001.source_span_text: Where area-based and census-based approaches are used in the same project, project proponents must ensure that accounting boundaries do not overlap.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-5-0001.normalized_requirement: Appendix 2 must be applied to test significance of carbon pools and GHG sources for de minimis treatment.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-5-0001.source_span_text: Appendix 2 of this methodology must be applied to test the significance of carbon pools and greenhouse gas (GHG) emission sources to determine whether they may be deemed de minimis.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-5-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Each census planting unit has a 10-meter radius buffer defining the instance accounting boundary; buffers may overlap within an instance but not with another instance.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-5-2-0001.source_span_text: In the census-based approach, each planting unit has a 10-meter radius buffer. Together, these buffers define the accounting boundary of a project activity instance. Buffers may overlap within the same instance but must not overlap with the boundary of another census- or area-based instance. This separation between instances prevents double counting.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-5-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Aboveground woody biomass is included in the census-based project boundary.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-5-2-0001.source_span_text: Aboveground woody Yes Major carbon pool

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-5-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Belowground woody biomass is included in the census-based project boundary.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-5-2-0001.source_span_text: Belowground woody Yes Major carbon pool

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-6-1-0001.normalized_requirement: The area-based crediting baseline is set using a performance benchmark based on representative control plots outside the project area.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-6-1-0001.source_span_text: A performance benchmark is used to set the crediting baseline. The performance benchmark, defined as the business-as-usual increase in vegetative cover relative to the project, is set based on data from representative control plots outside of the project area.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-6-1-0001.normalized_requirement: Appendix 1 procedures must be used to establish the performance benchmark.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-6-1-0001.source_span_text: Procedures to establish the performance benchmark are provided in Appendix 1.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-6-2-0001.normalized_requirement: The census project activity must occur in an area with less than 10% pre-existing woody biomass cover.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-6-2-0001.source_span_text: 1) occur within an area with pre-existing woody biomass cover of less than 10%; and

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-6-2-0001.normalized_requirement: The census project activity must occur in continuous cropping, settlements, or other lands categories.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-6-2-0001.source_span_text: 2) occur in an area subject to continuous cropping, or in “settlements,” or “other lands” land use categories.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-6-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Where both census baseline criteria are met, ARR may be assumed absent without project intervention and the crediting baseline is zero.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-6-2-0001.source_span_text: Where a project meets these criteria, it may be assumed that afforestation, reforestation, or revegetation will not occur without project interventions and the crediting baseline is set to zero.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-7-3-2-0001.normalized_requirement: The performance benchmark must follow Appendix 1 and applies only to the area-based approach.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-7-3-2-0001.source_span_text: The performance benchmark must be established following the procedures outlined in Appendix 1 and is applicable to the area-based approach only.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-7-3-2-0001.normalized_requirement: A significant difference between ΔSIcontrol,t and ΔSIwp,t under Appendix 1 Equation A7 demonstrates additionality for the performance benchmark.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-7-3-2-0001.source_span_text: Where parameters ΔSIcontrol,t and ΔSIwp,t are deemed significantly different (via Z test in Appendix 1 Equation (A7)), the project demonstrates additionality for the performance benchmark.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-7-3-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Validation requires an ex-ante expected difference and each verification must reassess additionality using the Appendix 1 A7 Z test.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-7-3-2-0001.source_span_text: To demonstrate additionality at validation, project proponents must apply an ex-ante calculation to demonstrate an expected difference between modeled performance of the project and the forecasted performance benchmark. Additionality must be reassessed at each verification using the Z test in Appendix 1, Equation (A7).

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-2-1-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Plot-based sampling before site preparation is the preferred t=0 method and must be used whenever possible.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-2-1-2-0001.source_span_text: 1) Plot-based sampling before site preparation is the preferred method and must be used whenever possible.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-2-1-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Where start is based on land use change and pre-start plots were unavailable, or preparation did not disturb woody biomass, plots may be established within two years after start and used as t=0.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-2-1-2-0001.source_span_text: 2) Where the project start date is based on a land use change date and plots could not be established beforehand, or where site preparation did not disturb pre-existing woody biomass, plots may be established and measured within two years after the project start date and used as the t = 0 estimate.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-2-1-2-0001.normalized_requirement: Remote sensing may establish disturbed pre-existing woody biomass at t=0 only under the stated pool, model, uncertainty, validation and spatial-resolution conditions.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-2-1-2-0001.source_span_text: 3) Where pre-existing woody biomass was disturbed before plot-based sampling, a remote sensing-based estimate may be used. This is allowed only where the project proponent demonstrates that no other significant carbon pools were affected during site preparation. Other carbon pools (e.g., SOC, dead wood, non-woody biomass) must not be estimated using remote sensing. Where a t = 0 estimate was not made, pools must either be eligible to be conservatively excluded or not have been disturbed. The remote sensing estimate of pre-existing woody biomass must meet the following conditions: a) The model predicts aboveground woody biomass using a stocking index-based regression model (see Appendix 1). b) The upper 90% confidence bound of the model’s prediction interval is used as the t = 0 biomass estimate to account for uncertainty. c) The model is significantly correlated with aboveground biomass, supported by published or peer-reviewed studies, or statistically validated with direct measurements from the same ecoregion as the project’s ecoregion. d) The spatial resolution is at least as fine as that of the remote sensing approach selected for the stocking index and meets all requirements listed in the parameter table for the stocking index in Appendix 1.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-2-1-4-0001.normalized_requirement: Dead wood t=0 must be established by plot-based sampling before disturbance, before site preparation, and no more than two years before project start.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-2-1-4-0001.source_span_text: Project proponents must establish a t = 0 estimate of dead wood through plot-based sampling before any disturbance (e.g., removal, burning, piling, or masticating). The plot-based sampling must be conducted before site preparation and no more than two years prior to the project start date.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-2-1-4-0001.normalized_requirement: Changes in dead wood caused by removal, burning, relocation or disturbance must be quantified using the stock difference method.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-2-1-4-0001.source_span_text: Changes in dead wood due to offsite removal, burning, relocation, or disturbance must be quantified using the stock difference method to ensure accurate accounting.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-4-0001.normalized_requirement: Area-based leakage emissions must use the most recent version of VMD0054.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-4-0001.source_span_text: Emissions from leakage (LKt) for the area-based approach are accounted using the most recent version of VMD0054.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-4-0001.normalized_requirement: For census-based quantification, LKt is zero because maintained agricultural production and the density threshold avoid significant land-use displacement.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-4-0001.source_span_text: In the census-based quantification approach, LKt is set equal to zero. The requirement that the ARR project activity maintains pre-project agricultural production levels avoids a change in land use and the planting density threshold avoids any significant displacement of a pre-existing land use due to land use changes such that leakage effects are assumed to be de minimis.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.normalized_requirement: At validation, ex-ante estimates must cover the crediting period and use conservative growth-and-yield data and parameters.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.source_span_text: 1) At validation, ex-ante estimates must be made for the length of the crediting period. Projected changes in biomass must be based on growth and yield models constructed with data and parameters that conservatively represent the project activity.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.normalized_requirement: Harvest regimes and forest-management activities must be incorporated into project-scenario modeling.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.source_span_text: 2) Any harvest regimes or forest management activities must be incorporated when modeling the project scenario.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.normalized_requirement: A minimum 10% uncertainty deduction must be applied, with a larger deduction permitted for conservativeness.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.source_span_text: 3) A minimum uncertainty deduction of 10% must be applied. An uncertainty deduction greater than 10% may be selected by the project proponent if they wish to be more conservative.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.normalized_requirement: Ex-ante removals must be derived using Equation 1 for area-based projects and Equation 22 for census-based projects with modeled growth-and-yield inputs as specified.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.source_span_text: 4) The ex-ante estimate of removals is derived as follows: a) For the area-based approach: Use Equation (1), with parameter ΔCWP-biomass,t from modeled growth and yield values: the output of the growth and yield model must provide an estimate in t C, which provides the value for ΔCWP-biomass,t used in Equation (1). b) For the census-based approach: Use Equation (22) with parameter ΔCWP-woody,t from modeled growth and yield values: the output of the growth and yield model must provide an estimate in t C, which provides the value for ΔCWP-woody,t used in Equation (22)

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.normalized_requirement: The ex-ante baseline is zero for census-based projects.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.source_span_text: 5) The ex-ante baseline is set to zero where the project uses the census-based approach.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.normalized_requirement: Area-based projects must forecast the performance benchmark using Appendix 1 and the specified modeled project and control stocking-index trends.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.source_span_text: 6) Projects using the area-based approach forecast a performance benchmark, which is determined by applying the procedures outlined in Appendix 1 with parameters estimated as follows: a) Expected changes in biomass (t C) over the crediting period are first estimated using a growth and yield model. A regression model based on published studies or validation datasets is then used to convert these biomass estimates into stocking index values to derive ΔSIwp,t. b) The change in stocking index for control plots may be estimated by assuming a linear trend between t = −10 and t = 0, using the slope of that interval as the basis for projecting performance across the crediting period to derive the ex-ante slope for ΔSIcontrol,t.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.normalized_requirement: Other carbon pools and GHG emission sources may be assumed zero where conservative.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-8-7-0001.source_span_text: 7) All other carbon pools (i.e., SOC) and GHG emission sources may be assumed to be zero, where it is conservative to do so.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The monitoring plan must specify the quantification approach and define the planting unit for census projects or follow Section 9.3.1 for area-based projects.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.source_span_text: 1) Specification of the quantification approach applied (i.e., area-based, census-based, or a combination of both). Where using the census-based approach, the plan must clearly define the planting unit. If using the area-based approach, see procedures in Section 9.3.1.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The monitoring plan must describe each monitoring task and its technical requirements.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.source_span_text: 2) A description of each monitoring task to be undertaken, and the technical requirements therein.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The monitoring plan must define the accounting boundary and demonstrate non-overlap where approaches are combined.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.source_span_text: 3) Definition of the accounting boundary. Where area-based and census-based quantification approaches are used in the same project, the monitoring plan must specify the spatial accounting boundary for the area-based approach and demonstrate non-overlap with the census-based approach (applying area specifications detailed in Section 5).

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The monitoring plan must identify measured parameters, including parameter tables for directly measured woody plant attributes used in allometric equations.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.source_span_text: 4) Parameters to be measured, including parameter tables for all directly measured woody plant attributes (e.g., diameter at breast height, total height) incorporated as independent variables in allometric equations.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The monitoring plan must specify data, collection techniques, SOPs, sample design and unbiased population estimators.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.source_span_text: 5) Data to be collected and data collection techniques, including data used in monitoring of the performance benchmark, documented in a standard operating procedure for field data collection. Sample designs must be specified (clearly delineate the sample population, justify sampling intensities, selection of sample units, and sampling stages, where applicable) and un-biased estimators of population parameters that are applied in calculations identified.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The monitoring plan must specify anticipated monitoring frequency for each variable.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.source_span_text: 6) Anticipated frequency of monitoring for each variable

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The monitoring plan must specify QA/QC for accuracy, anomaly correction, completeness and independent analytical checks.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.source_span_text: 7) QA/QC procedures to ensure accurate data collection and to screen for, and where necessary, correct anomalous values, ensure completeness, perform independent checks on analysis results, and other safeguards as appropriate

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.normalized_requirement: Monitoring data and QA/QC data must be electronically archived, including format-update procedures, for at least two years after the last crediting period.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.source_span_text: 8) Data archiving procedures, including procedures for any anticipated updates to electronic file formats. All data collected as a part of the monitoring process, including QA/QC data, must be archived electronically and kept for at least two years after the end of the last project crediting period.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The monitoring plan must define team roles, responsibilities, capacity, chain of custody, data repository and maintenance responsibilities.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.source_span_text: 9) Roles, responsibilities, and capacity of the monitoring team and management. Roles and responsibilities defined for chain of custody, repositing, and maintenance of all data.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The monitoring plan must specify the schedule and procedures for acquiring, archiving and processing remote sensing data used to derive stocking indices.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.source_span_text: 10) Specific schedule and procedures for periodically acquiring, archiving, and processing remote sensing data to derive stocking indices

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The monitoring plan must fully describe the stocking index and how it is derived; a database reference alone is insufficient.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-0001.source_span_text: 11) A full description of the stocking index, and the process to derive it (reference to the database is insufficient)

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-1-0001.normalized_requirement: The area-based plot database must describe the stocking index and its derivation process.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-1-0001.source_span_text: 1) a description of the stocking index and the process used to derive it;

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-1-0001.normalized_requirement: The database must list project plots with IDs, locations, size/configuration and stocking-index time series from t=0 to t.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-1-0001.source_span_text: 2) a list of project plots including unique IDs, locations, size and configuration, and time series of stocking index values from time t = 0 to time t;

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-1-0001.normalized_requirement: The database must list control plots with matched project IDs, locations, size/configuration, weights and stocking-index time series from t=0 to t.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-1-0001.source_span_text: 3) a list of control plots including unique IDs (referencing unique ID of corresponding project plot to which they are matched), locations, size and configuration, weights, and time series of stocking index values from time t = 0 to time t; and

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-1-0001.normalized_requirement: The database must retain remote sensing datasets and timestamps used to derive stocking-index values.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-9-3-1-0001.source_span_text: 4) remote sensing datasets and time stamps used to derive stocking index values.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-1-0001.normalized_requirement: Appendix 1 applies only where the project meets all Section 4 applicability conditions.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-1-0001.source_span_text: 1) The project meets all applicability conditions detailed in Section 4 of this methodology.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-1-0001.normalized_requirement: Project activities must produce vegetative cover allowing clear spatial delineation of the project area.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-1-0001.source_span_text: 2) The project activities will produce vegetative cover allowing for clear spatial delineation of the project area.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-1-0001.normalized_requirement: The performance benchmark must be updated at each verification or every five years, whichever occurs first.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-1-0001.source_span_text: 3) The project’s performance benchmark is updated at each verification or every five years, whichever comes first.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-2-0001.normalized_requirement: The baseline scenario is business-as-usual aboveground biomass growth observed on representative remotely sensed control plots outside registered AFOLU project areas.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-2-0001.source_span_text: The baseline scenario is represented by the business-as-usual growth of carbon stocks in aboveground biomass, as observed on representative remotely sensed control plots located outside of any registered AFOLU project area.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-2-0001.normalized_requirement: The performance benchmark represents business-as-usual vegetation change and the baseline is re-established each verification using the updated benchmark.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-2-0001.source_span_text: The business-as-usual changes in vegetation cover are represented by the performance benchmark, which is equal to the ratio of average change in stocking index (SI) of control plots to project plots. The control plots are appropriately matched to the project plots based on similar biophysical, social, and political conditions, and historic stock trends (see Section A1.4). SI in control plots is detected using remote sensing and does not need direct field measurement. The baseline is established at every verification period through the application of an updated performance benchmark.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-3-0001.normalized_requirement: A performance benchmark is developed for each project area, or separately for each annual cohort in grouped projects, and is dynamic because it is monitored ex-post.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-3-0001.source_span_text: A performance benchmark is developed for each project area, or in the case of grouped projects, a separate performance benchmark is developed for each annual cohort of instances. Performance benchmarks are monitored ex-post, hence are dynamic.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-3-0001.normalized_requirement: The ex-ante benchmark must use control-plot stocking indices from t=-10 to t=0, while the project slope comes from the Section 8.7 growth-and-yield procedure.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-3-0001.source_span_text: An ex-ante estimate of the performance benchmark must be calculated referencing a value of ΔSIcontrol,t using the stocking indices for the historic period t = −10 to t = 0 for the selected control plots (derived in Section A1.4). The project slope is derived from the growth and yield curve procedure provided in ex-ante calculations (see Section 8.7).

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-4-0007.normalized_requirement: For each annual cohort, the project area must be divided into equal-sized contiguous non-overlapping project plots from 0.01 to 10 ha, with at least 75% of each unit inside the project boundary.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-4-0007.source_span_text: 1) Divide the entire project annual cohort area into equal-sized, contiguous, non-overlapping units (project plots) with area ranging from 0.01 hectares (10 × 10 m) to 10 hectares. At least 75% of each unit must be within the project area boundary. Project plots may be represented by individual pixels or aggregates of pixels.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-4-0007.normalized_requirement: At least 30 representative project plots must be randomly sampled across the project area.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-4-0007.source_span_text: 2) Select a representative sample of n = 30 or more project plots across the project area using random sampling.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-4-0007.normalized_requirement: Strata may contain fewer than 30 plots only if the total sample is at least 30 and each stratum has a separate performance benchmark.
Verra.AFOLU.VM0047.v1-1.R-11-4-0007.source_span_text: Note – If the project is stratified or is a grouped project where new instances are added in subsequent years, individual strata may contain fewer than 30 plots, provided the total sample size is at least 30 and each stratum is used to establish a separate performance benchmark.
